# EngineLineChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasEngineLineChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineLineChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineLineChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineLineChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartEngineElement`](UltraCanvasChartEngineElement.md) → [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Any of the charts above **on the chart engine** — themes, measured layout, solved labels, tooltips, Vertical / Horizontal / Polar — compared with the legacy ones on the demo's *Chart Engine Comparison* page (`UltraCanvasEngineCharts.md`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasEngineLineChart> CreateEngineLineChart( const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasEngineLineChart(const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

### enum `EngineLineChartMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Line` | strokes only |
| `Area` | each series filled down to zero, overlapping |
| `StackedArea` | bands piled up per domain position |
| `PercentStackedArea` | bands sharing out 100% per domain position |

### struct `EngineLinePointStyle`

One point's own look, overriding its series': an outlier, the latest value, a point that breaks a control chart rule. Fields left at their defaults keep the series' look.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `color` | `Color color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)` | alpha 0 = the series' marker colour |
| `marker` | `std::optional<ChartMarkerShape> marker` | unset = the series' marker |
| `hollow` | `bool hollow = false` | outline only, in the colour above |
| `radiusScale` | `float radiusScale = 1.0f` |  |
| `alwaysShown` | `bool alwaysShown = false` | drawn even when the series hides markers |

### struct `EngineLineBand`

A filled band between two series, point by point - a confidence interval, a min / max envelope, the zones under control limits that change from point to point. Drawn under the lines, through the pane of the lower series; where either series has a gap the band has one too.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `lowerSeries` | `size_t lowerSeries = 0` |  |
| `upperSeries` | `size_t upperSeries = 0` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)` | alpha 0 = the upper series' colour |
| `opacity` | `float opacity = 0.15f` |  |
| `shape` | `std::optional<ChartLineShape> shape` | unset = the upper series' shape |

### struct `EngineLinePane`

One of several stacked panes sharing the domain axis (SetPanes): each has its own value axis, grid and title in a sub-band of the plot - a range chart under its averages, an indicator under a price.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `weight` | `double weight = 1.0` | share of the plot, relative to the others |
| `valueTitle` | `std::string valueTitle` | empty = the chart's value title (pane 0) / none |
| `includeZero` | `bool includeZero = false` |  |
| `rangeIncludes` | `std::vector<double> rangeIncludes` | Values the pane's axis always reaches, data or not: control limits, a target. A limiter outside its axis's range is not drawn. |

### enum `EngineLineSpanKind`

A dimension line measured between the TOP edges of two series' bands - the cumulative flow diagram's annotations. AcrossDomain runs at value `at` from where the first series' edge reaches it to where the second's does (lead / cycle time); AcrossValue stands at domain position `at` (an index, or an x value) between the two edges (WIP). NaN `at` = automatic placement (half the final stack total / a third of the way along); a negative `at` on an AcrossDomain span is that fraction of the final total (-0.38 = 38%).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AcrossDomain` |  |
| `AcrossValue` |  |

How ShowControlChart draws a control chart. Colours with alpha 0 come from the chart's theme, so a dark theme keeps working.

| `showSpecLimits` | `bool showSpecLimits = true` | USL / LSL / target from the result |
